messages:
Sam P: quick debrief from the midnight incident. big thanks to folks who responded. two recurring pain points: (a) fragmented handoffs — important context lost when people leave shift, and (b) no reliable place for action items, so follow-ups are slipping.

Leah W: yea the pages were noisy and once I got paged I couldn't find a single source of truth for who picked up which mitigation. the oncall alias also sent to an old group for ~10m.

Mike R: confirmed. the pager mapping still pointed at legacy-team@pager. fixed at 02:48 UTC. we need a sanity check whenever we change team ownerships.

ops-bot: Alert: token-store error rate above threshold at 02:13 UTC. Pages issued to: eng-oncall, infra. Acknowledged: Mike R.

Anya S: during the live incident the response was fine, but afterwards: nobody spun up a post-incident record. we keep promising to write things up and then they fall through the cracks.

Sam P: proposal: build an "afteraction-bot" that does three things automatically for P1/P2 incidents: 1) create a standardized postmortem ticket (GH/Jira) with timeline snippet; 2) DM an outgoing oncall at shift end with a short handoff checklist; 3) populate a tracking dashboard of open post-incident actions with owners and due dates.

Leah W: dashboard is key. also we should include a customer-impact flag so CSMs can quickly get a one-click summary to send to customers.

Mike R: for the ticket template, suggest forcing structure. sample:

```
title: Incident <id> — <short desc>
severity: P1|P2
start: <ts>
end: <ts>
customer_impact: yes/no (auto-draft)
summary: auto-generated 2-3 sentence blurb for CSMs
timeline: pasted last N messages + key events
actions:
- [ ] owner: @name — due YYYY-MM-DD — short desc
- [ ] owner: @name — due YYYY-MM-DD — short desc
```

Anya S: nice. small niceties: let primary responder opt-in to be initial owner, otherwise auto-assign to rotations lead. also support `/afteraction reassign @someone 5d` quick command.

devex-bot: idea: scheduler that finds all incidents tagged P1/P2 and creates a calendar invite for a 60-min postmortem within 72 hours. attendees: responders + product + CSM.

Sam P: handoff DM flow suggestion: ops-bot DMs outgoing oncall at T-minus 15m with a checklist link: active incidents, links to any created postmortem tickets, outstanding actions, and an "acknowledge handoff" button that records the handoff event. if not acknowledged, escalate to next oncall after 10m.

Leah W: that would've saved us last night. I had TODOs in thread replies that I forgot to convert into issues. if the bot extracts that list it helps a lot.

Mike R: implementation plan (high level):
- wire incident service -> afteraction-bot
- when severity >= P2: bot creates ticket, attaches timeline snippet (rolling 30m window), attaches logs pointer, posts link in incident channel
- bot computes `customer_impact` via alert tags + manual toggle in the ticket UI

Anya S: process rules: actions default to 7-day SLA for critical, 30-day for non-critical. auto-escalate actions with no progress after 7 days: ping owner + manager and mark as overdue on dashboard.

Sam P: UX: when bot creates the ticket, post a threaded summary in the incident channel with actionable buttons: assign, set-due, add-comment. this avoids extra context switching.

Jordan B: quick note from PM side: please include a short, editable customer blurb in the ticket so CSMs can review and copy to customers. format should be one paragraph + bullet list of impacted endpoints/customers.

Leah W: for the dashboard, I'll prototype queries in Grafana and also an internal portal widget. want filters: owner, team, due-status, customer-impact.

Mike R: I'll take the ticket creation PoC + the customer blurb generator. will include thread permalink and a top-N snapshot of messages.

Anya S: I'll own the handoff DM and acknowledge flow. will include optional checkbox: "handoff notes copied to ticket".

Sam P: owners noted: @Mike R — ticket PoC + blurb; @Anya S — handoff DM; @Leah W — dashboard + escalations. @Jordan B for PM review and CSM workflow sign-off.

devex-bot: follow-up suggestion: when afteraction-bot opens a ticket it should also label the incident with `postmortem-required` and tag watchers based on touched services.

Mike R: timeline for MVP (suggestion):
- week 0: spec + ticket template (this week)
- week 1: PoC: ticket creation + timeline attach + channel post
- week 2: handoff DM + ack flow
- week 3: dashboard + overdue escalation alerts

Leah W: I'll aim to have dashboards queries and a simple front-end by end of week 2.

Anya S: router: please make sure the handoff DM includes a link back to the exact thread message IDs. otherwise traceability suffers.

Sam P: agreed. also include a short checklist in tickets: "customer notified?" "rolling workaround?" "deploy blocker?".

afteraction-bot: Created ticket: https://jira.company/AA-502 — owner: @Mike R — actions: 4 — due window: 7d

Leah W: small extra ask: allow marking an action as "cross-team" so we can add multiple owners/watchers automatically.

Mike R: can do. will add a `cross_team:true` checkbox and multiple owner fields.

devex-bot: action items recorded: [Ticket PoC] owner=@Mike R due=2026-03-21, [Handoff DM] owner=@Anya S due=2026-03-21, [Dashboard] owner=@Leah W due=2026-03-21.

Sam P: please write short PRDs into #devex by EOD Friday with acceptance criteria: bot creates ticket for P2+, ticket link posted in channel, DM sent at handoff, dashboard shows at least one open action.

Jordan B: will review the PRDs and coordinate with CSMs for the customer summary format.

Mike R: I'll post PoC updates in this thread. starting tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-14T02:13Z — archived to incident-log at 03:12 UTC.

Sam P: thanks everyone — I'll draft an RFC and put it in #devex for review. :+1:
